v01-man-afraid.observed_description: A white-haired man in a green sweater shrinks back with wide eyes and an open mouth, both palms raised, looking at something off to the side. One person.
v01-man-afraid.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.

v05-boys-tennis.observed_description: Two teenage boys in plain blue shirts play tennis on an indoor court, seen from the side: one hits the yellow ball with his racket, the other waits with his racket; the net runs across the front. Two people.
v05-boys-tennis.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). The meaning is plain at 180 px and nothing readable is written in the photo.
